record.title: Exercise owned recorder shutdown through sealed offline review
record.intent: Verify that the independently reusable components compose at their lifecycle boundaries.
requirements: Use only a fixed synthetic child and public manufactured fixture to exercise readiness graceful stop final statistics sealing and composed review in one host-only control.
Preserve the distinction between the observed child lifecycle and synthetic packet or counter provenance; do not add a live capture or instrument command.
Retain abnormal-exit and counter-disagreement controls that prevent a successful downstream claim, preserving each outcome separately.
Run the composed public-library consumer from source and installed distributions outside the checkout and document its ownership and cleanup responsibilities.
acceptance: One host-only end-to-end control connects actual owned-child termination to immutable retained synthetic review inputs with explicit negative outcomes.
